question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**overcome**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about a former captain of an Indian wheelchair-cricket team who was forced to work as a labourer.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**overcome**'.
 
• It means **'to manage to control or defeat somebody/something'. **(व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को पराजित या नियंत्रित कर लेना)
 
 
• *Example: She tried hard to **overcome** her fear of flying.*
 
 
 
• The given sentence is expressing the fact that the former captain was resilient and that he would win over the difficulties that he was facing.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *According to a news report, a former captain of the Indian wheelchair cricket team has now been forced to __work__ (1) as a labourer to support his family. In the context of the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown, the children he used to __coach__ (2) earlier have stopped coming to him for a few months. Their parents said there was no money to pay for their __training__ (3). Before the lockdown, he was giving coaching to wheelchair-bound children who were __interested__ (4) in playing cricket. The coach has now returned to his village where his old parents live. He said to the reporter who interviewed him, “These are difficult times, but I know I will be able to **__**overcome**__* *(5) them,” with a smile on his face.*
